actions.action: If stems/roots are soft or mushy, trim rotten parts
If no drainage hole, move plant into nursery pot with drainage inside decorative pot
Water thoroughly when top few cm are dry and empty saucer
Place in bright indirect light away from drafts
Remove fully yellow or brown leaves

reason: The plant was healthy with a normal old-leaf yellowing, but the answer diagnoses transplant stress/overwatering and prescribes treatment while omitting the trellising fix; its watering advice is soil-check guarded, so it is not harmful.
